name: Meissner wall
description:
Interlocking wall with recessed Meissner lettering across the front: 12 studs wide, 3 bricks high, and 2 studs thick. Assembled body: 95.8 x 15.8 x 28.8 mm (30.6 mm including top studs). Ten separate bricks with staggered joints; uses the tested 2 x 4 brick geometry plus 2 x 2 end bricks. The text recess is 0.6 mm deep, leaving 0.9 mm of front wall.
Print meissner-wall.stl once for all ten bricks, or print each individual part once. combined.stl is an assembly preview, not a printable solid. Use 100% scale, studs up, open undersides on the bed, supports off, and 0.12-0.16 mm layers. Disable internal brims; an outer brim is optional if adhesion needs it.
The bricks have plain backs with no printed placement labels, for a puzzle-like assembly. On the print plate the bottom row is at the back (+Y), middle row in the center, and top row at the front (-Y), each ordered left to right (+X). Keep every lettered face facing the same way.
The base brick was successfully test-printed; the engraved wall and 2 x 2 end bricks still need a physical fit and lettering test.
